name: Machi Gurumi no Wana ~Hakudaku ni Mamireta Yuuri~
original_name: 町ぐるみの罠～ 白濁にまみれた優理～
source:
“Please! Stop!”  
The people she saved reach out with lust-filled eyes, their hands groping her body— 

Yuuri, after a certain incident, is guided by the angelic goddess Holy Rouge, Suzune, to bravely fight to protect her friends, loved ones, and the peace of the human world.  
Transforming into Angel Tear, she battles demons.  
But the demons, seeing through Angel Tear’s kind nature, set cunning traps.  
Once she exhausts her energy, they deliberately corrupt the men she saves, threatening her: “If you want to save them, you’ll have to satisfy their sexual desires.”  

But that’s not all.  
There are others targeting Angel Tear—men she saved from the demons’ clutches.  
Men who, realizing she’s out of energy, attack her with lecherous eyes.  
Men who lie about being threatened by demons to force her into sexual servitude.  
Men who blackmail her, saying they’ll expose her identity if she doesn’t comply.  

Yuuri, whether transformed or not, finds herself constantly targeted by the very people she’s saved…  

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20180317171240/http://www.syrup-soft.jp/mm/megami/story.html]the official website[/url]]
